location_address: 2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA US 92106
description:
#Welcome Aboard!

Triton Charters is San Diego’s largest and newest Catamaran Yacht Charter. On August 1st, 2020, Triton completed its extended 38-day journey and docked in the San Diego Bay. We hold Coast Guard certification for a maximum of 100 passengers on board, with Ticketed Charters accommodating up to 80 guests, ensuring ample space for everyone!
what_is_included:
- Coast Guard certified captain and crew members
- Spacious open seating floor plan 
- Full 13-seat bar to purchase a variety of alcoholic and non alcoholic beverages
- Dance floor with a variety of music playing
- 2 upscale bathrooms
- Multiple bean bags for lounging on the bow
- Easy stair access from the dock to the boat
- Family friendly, we welcome all ages!
- Live music on select charters

itinerary: This ticketed cruise will take you through San Diego Bay to splash by all the major monuments including the USS Midway and under the Coronado Bridge! Our captain and crew will guide your adventure throughout San Diego Bay for fresh air, great music, delicious drinks, and gorgeous views.
